content: Ahrangtho ning taitah a za ung thahpaw, a kong khah ca kaa cakuapaw he a cang. Ma cawh Hringnah Bia cang ka kaa naw tah thui ka, kaa meh tah hmuh ka, ming peh ka kaa kih tah a tawng thah.
Hringnah cawh a va paly. Kaaning tah ma cawh hmuh he peh ka, a dawkhui he peh ka, Paw khatah ung katei, kaaning kha a za palypaw chaizaw hringnah cawh naaning khatah kaa y khui hi.

Kaa hmuhpaw le kaa thuipaw khah naaning khatah kaa y khui, ma pawsui co kaaning khatah na pakong khy hrá he ceh. Taico ka huikongnah pawhe peh cawh Paw le a Sawcapaw Zisu Khri khatei a huikongnah khah a cang.
Ka lawngnah pawhe peh tlingsah rua pawtah ma ca heh kaa ca kuapaw he a cang.
Ma bia heh a Sawcapaw taitah thui he peh katei, naaning kaa ca chingpaw he cawh a cang. Khazing cawh khainah cang ka, Ama a chung leco muinah zehmai ung be.
Ama khatah a huikongnah kaa hnui tah he peh katei, muinah chung letah kaa cinglai thlang thly caco, hing he peh ka, biahmuisui letah ung bei peh tahnah a cang.

Canghrasala Ama cawh khainah chung letah a ungpaw hratah kaaning zong khainah chung letah kaa cinglai caco, pakheh le pakheh a huikongnah hnui he peh ka, a Sawcapaw Zisu thihnah thisai tah kaaning cawh suanah vytei taitah a ma pathaisá a.
Kaaning tah suanah hnui bei peh kaa tah caco, kaaning le kaaning a dungkheipaw cang he peh ka, kaa chung letah biahmuisui ung be tahnah a cang.
Kaa suanah kaa phy caco, Ama cawh zingchuipaw le a dingpaw cang ka, kaa suanah sahlo khah ma ngethai ka, dinglynah vytei taitah a ma pathaisá a.
Sua bei peh kaa tah caco, Khazing cawh mehing tah tua peh ka, a bia cawh kaa hringnah chung letah hminghmaw hnui be tahnah a cang.
